intro: Covers lessons 5 to 6 of Physical features of the UK (Marvellous Medicine). Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: The highest mountain in the UK is:
questions.a: B) Ben Nevis. Ben Nevis in Scotland is 1,345 m. Yr Wyddfa is highest in Wales and Scafell Pike in England.

questions.q: The longest river in the UK is:
questions.a: B) The Severn. The Severn is slightly longer than the Thames.
